scope: Independent design/proof review for the fixed N24 producer approach only; no implementation, source activation, consumer, admission, native/Premium, or full BIZQ-01 acceptance claim.

designFindings.basis: The map/proof bind the current N23 baseline, exact 18 source paths and hashes, the 36/288 item partition, accepted answer identities and full before/current question objects. Independent reconstruction reproduces all 18 proposed current source hashes and the proposed full OOD QSet.

The N23 validator already provides the matching fixed-version pattern: exact proof bytes and version/QSet checks, strict source/item membership, path checks, full-object equality, byte-exact private predecessor reconstruction, and delegation to the unchanged predecessor proof chain. N24 is disjoint from the N07 source paths.

The proposed N24 historical ingress composes with the existing v23-to-v22 private fixture restoration and retains the older immutable proof chain. Focused per-question scorer/reversal/feedback checks and canonical registration are scoped to the existing N24 contract.

limitations: This review does not verify the future N24 verifier implementation, activated source files, producer tests, canonical suite, candidate, app synchronization, admission, or web export.
No new global option-ID uniqueness rule is inferred; the existing validator's per-question identity checks remain the design reference.
